title: The Naked Man
prompt: A naked man was found dead at the foot of a mountain with a match in his hand.
solution: A hot air balloon with four passengers had drifted off course and was about to crash into a mountain. To gain height, the passengers threw all the ballast overboard, including their clothes. It wasn't enough: one of them had to jump. They drew matches to decide, and the dead man drew the shortest one.
